_help.company_name: required. Display name, shown in the dashboard.
_help.company_id: required. Letters, digits . _ - only. Used as the folder name under runs/ and must be unique.
_help.tenant_id: required. Tenant GUID or the tenant's onmicrosoft.com / verified domain name.
_help.app: required. App label, not a secret. 'app-1' reads ENTRA_APP_1_CLIENT_ID and ENTRA_APP_1_CLIENT_SECRET from .env.
_help.enabled: optional, default true. false skips this company.
_help.emergency_access_ids: optional. Object ids of the break-glass accounts or groups, used by the emergency-access checks.
_help.workloads: optional. Collect only these: entra, intune, exchange, teams, sharepoint, compliance, defender, azure. Empty or missing = all except azure.
_help.exclude_workloads: optional. Collect everything except these. Applied after 'workloads'.
_help.domains: optional. Verified domains in scope for the SPF/DKIM/DMARC checks. Empty or missing = every verified domain.
